hooks.text: There is no permanent dark side of the Moon.
The far side of the Moon gets as much sunlight as the near side.
During a new Moon, the far side is bathed in blazing daylight.

title: The Moon Has No Dark Side
description: Discover the truth about the lunar far side and how it receives just as much sunlight as the side we see.

beats.text: There is no permanent dark side of the Moon.
beats.visual: NASA Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter photograph of the lunar far side, 2011
queries: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter far side of the Moon

beats.text: Pop culture claims one hemisphere is shrouded in endless shadow.
beats.visual: Diagram illustrating lunar phases and near and far side illumination by NASA SVS
queries: Lunar Near and Far Side Phases NASA SVS

beats.text: In October 1959, the Soviet Luna 3 probe beamed back the first grainy photographs of the unseen hemisphere.
beats.visual: Luna 3 first transmitted photograph of the far side of the Moon, 1959
queries: Luna 3 far side of the Moon first photograph

beats.text: Direct radio contact with Earth is completely blocked behind the lunar globe.
beats.visual: Artist concept of communication relay satellite communicating with lunar far side, 2019
queries: Queqiao relay satellite lunar far side

beats.text: On January 3, 2019, China's Chang'e 4 mission achieved the first soft landing on this rugged terrain.
beats.visual: Chang'e 4 lander photograph on the lunar far side surface, 2019

beats.text: When Earth sees a full Moon, the far side is cast in complete darkness.
beats.visual: Lunar near and far side illumination phases diagram by Goddard Space Flight Center
queries: Moon far side phases diagram Goddard

beats.text: Yet during a new Moon, the far side is bathed in blazing daylight.
beats.visual: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter image of illuminated lunar far side craters, 2015
queries: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Moon surface craters

beats.text: Both halves cycle through sunlight equally, proving there is no permanent dark side of the Moon.
beats.visual: NASA animation of Moon orbiting Earth showing sunlight hitting both sides, 2018
queries: Moon orbit Earth sun illumination NASA

better_than_last: This episode applies a tight mystery structure with a contradiction hook that flows seamlessly into the first beat to maximize viewer retention.
